clusterPlan.assignment: labelled points assigned to their own type's source blob; kmeans over the points with no label

faithfulness.definition: correlation between 32-d cosine distance and 3D euclidean distance over random point pairs; 1.0 = distances fully meaningful

knnAgreement.definition: share of a point's 3D k nearest neighbours sharing its type

neighbourhood.definition: trustworthiness = of the points drawn near a point, the share that belong near it (the picture inventing neighbours); continuity = of the points that belong near it, the share drawn near it (the picture hiding them). 1 is perfect, about 0.5 is what a random arrangement scores

tearing.definition: clusters this projection draws in two places at once, so their centroid — where the label, the trajectory and the wave all go — lands between two blobs instead of on the points; splitting a single blob scores ~2, so 2 is the null and 'torn' counts above 5

mapQuality.split: by recording, 80/20; every knob — penalties, sigma, and which map class ships — was chosen on a further 80/20 split of the fit side, never on these rows
mapQuality.definition: cosine between the mapped 28-d descriptor and the true critic embedding, on syllables of recordings the map was not fitted on
mapQuality.centroidAgreementDefinition: share of held-out syllables whose nearest cluster centroid of this galaxy is the same through the 28-d -> 32-d map as through the critic
mapQuality.centroidAgreementTieAdjustedDefinition: the same agreement with boundary near-ties excluded (true-space top-2 margin under 0.05; the share of flips that are a near-miss between adjacent knots rather than a wrong bird, per docs/20)
mapQuality.speciesAgreementDefinition: share of held-out syllables whose nearest knot carries the same majority species through the map as through the critic — the honest single-label claim; knot-level answers are 'nearest of several close knots' (docs/20 §20.2)

embedding.centroidVectors: vector32 = 32-d embedding centroid (primary); vector = 28-d centroid over the same members, for the pre-embedding fallback

kmeans.fittedOver: the points with no label only
kmeans.assignment: labelled points assigned to their own type's source blob; kmeans over the points with no label

positions.normalisation: centred on the bbox midpoint, scaled so max|coord| = 1

pointFeatures.space: PCA of the standardised 32-d feature space, rows unit-normalised
pointFeatures.purpose: per-point render response only; the reported match still uses the cluster centroid vectors

functionClasses.definition: behavioural class of each cluster's documented function, matched against the keyword table below in order; the first hit wins

clusterPurityNote: 1.0 by construction: label assignment puts each typed point in its own type's cluster, so purity and typeCoverage measure nothing here. The statistic that still measures the map is whether a point's nearest centroid is its own type's knot (docs/22 §22.8)

matchRamp.definition: best-centroid cosine over real harvested field syllables; the browser ramps activation strength between floor and ceiling with a smoothstep, so below the floor nothing lights and above the ceiling a match reads as certain
